name: brotab
title: Brotab
description: Tabs, history, bookmarks, closed tabs and notes from the browser, with real screenshots and history deletion.
author: black

commands.name: tabs-list
commands.title: List Open Tabs
commands.subtitle: Brotab
commands.description: Every tab brotab reports, with actions to activate, close, screenshot or note it.

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: History
commands.subtitle: Brotab
commands.description: The browser's history, newest first, searched by title or URL; delete one entry or a whole period.

commands.name: bookmarks
commands.title: Bookmarks
commands.subtitle: Brotab
commands.description: The browser's bookmarks with their folders, searched by title or URL.

commands.name: clear-history
commands.title: Clear History
commands.subtitle: Brotab
commands.description: Delete history for a period, optionally with the cookies and cache from the same period.

commands.name: closed-tabs
commands.title: Recently Closed Tabs
commands.subtitle: Brotab
commands.description: Tabs the browser has closed, newest first, from its session store.

commands.name: notes
commands.title: Notes
commands.subtitle: Brotab
commands.description: Notes kept per page URL, searched and written here or from the search bar.
